desktop_rewrite_responsibilities.currentImplementation: Next.js standalone server on http://127.0.0.1:8502 serves UI and rewrites /api/* to http://127.0.0.1:5055
desktop_rewrite_responsibilities.migrationTarget: Native host (Tauri HTTP server or Wails embedded asset server) serves static UI and proxies /api/* to http://127.0.0.1:5055

desktop_rewrite_responsibilities.currentImplementation: Next.js same-origin proxy eliminates browser cross-origin requests
desktop_rewrite_responsibilities.migrationTarget: Native host embedded proxy serves UI and API under single origin http://127.0.0.1:8502 or configures CORS headers

desktop_rewrite_responsibilities.currentImplementation: Next.js Node.js HTTP proxy stream with Disabled Buffering header
desktop_rewrite_responsibilities.migrationTarget: Native host HTTP proxy with flush-on-chunk / zero-buffer streaming response

desktop_rewrite_responsibilities.currentImplementation: Next.js bodyParser-disabled HTTP proxy stream for file uploads
desktop_rewrite_responsibilities.migrationTarget: Native host streaming body proxy with original Content-Type / Content-Length headers

blockers_to_static_build.title: Absence of Node.js Reverse Proxy for /api/*
blockers_to_static_build.impact: Static build (Vite/HTML) cannot route /api/* to FastAPI backend without an active HTTP proxy or CORS enablement.
blockers_to_static_build.resolution: Shift API reverse proxy responsibility to the native desktop host (Rust/Tauri in X19).

blockers_to_static_build.title: SPA Client Route HTML Fallback
blockers_to_static_build.impact: Direct navigation or browser refresh on deep routes (e.g., /notebooks/xyz) returns 404 on static HTTP file servers.
blockers_to_static_build.resolution: Configure native host embedded web server to serve index.html for all non-file route requests.
